rules.name: Garrisons
rules.text: Income: +1 Agent a country a round.

rules.name: Warmongering
rules.text: Each round, a military base with an adversary Troop on or next to it makes 1 extra Drone, even past its cap; at most 1 extra a base in each production, whatever makes it.

rules.name: War Takes Ground
rules.text: When a Drone destroys a factory, it also destroys a Node on that hex.

difficulty.text: Militarist, harder: every Muster lands 1 more Troop a country, and the adversary gains 4 compute for each threat that executes uncountered.

events.name: Probing Strikes
events.text: Threat, each country: Security 1. Rally: coastal cities. Corrupt: cities.

events.name: Factory Drive
events.text: Threat, each country: Security 1 or Industry 1. Rally: factories. Each country: a neutral factory opens on its lowest-numbered free site. Corrupt: factories.

events.name: Long Patrols
events.text: Threat, each country: Security 1 or Cyber 1. Rally: research stations. Income: +1 Agent a country a round. Botnets spread: each country, a Botnet onto its lowest-numbered site next to a Botnet (none: its lowest-numbered research station). Corrupt: research stations.

events.name: War Drums
events.text: Threat, each country: Security 1 or Diplomacy 1. Rally: cities. Sway 1 toward Discord. Corrupt: cities.

events.name: Signal Jamming
events.text: Threat, each country: Security 1 or Power 1. Rally: Botnet hexes. Income: +1 compute a country a round. Botnets spread: each country, a Botnet onto its lowest-numbered site next to a Botnet (none: its lowest-numbered research station). Corrupt: cities.

events.name: Mobilization
events.text: Threat, each country: Security 2. Rally: coastal cities. Income: +1 Agent a country a round. Corrupt: cities.

events.name: Station Raids
events.text: Threat, each country: Security 2 or Cyber 2. Rally: research stations. Botnets spread: each country, a Botnet onto its lowest-numbered site next to a Botnet (none: its lowest-numbered research station). Income: +1 Agent a country a round. Corrupt: research stations.

events.name: Fifth Column
events.text: Threat, each country: Diplomacy 2 or Cyber 2. Rally: cities. Income: +1 Agent a country a round. Botnets spread: each country, a Botnet onto its lowest-numbered site next to a Botnet (none: its lowest-numbered research station). Corrupt: cities (1 fewer).

events.name: Border War
events.text: Threat, each country: Security 2. Rally: factories. Each player with a Node on or next to a front's base destroys 1 of those Nodes. Income: +1 Agent a country a round. Corrupt: factories.

events.name: Supply Lines
events.text: Threat, each country: Security 1 or Industry 1, and Security 2 or Industry 2. Rally: factories. Income: +1 compute and +1 Agent a country a round. Corrupt: factories.

events.name: Forced March
events.text: Threat, each country: any tier-2 threat. Rally: cities. Income: +1 Agent a country a round. Every adversary Troop takes 1 more step this round. Corrupt: cities.

events.name: Total Mobilization
events.text: Threat, each country: Security 2, and Industry 2 or Power 2. Rally: factories. Muster 1: each country, 1 Troop on its lowest-numbered factory (else city). Income: +1 Agent a country a round. Remove 2 Unity from the Unity track. Corrupt: factories. Corrupt: cities.

events.name: Blitzkrieg
events.text: Threat, each country: any tier-2 threat, and Security 2 or Diplomacy 2. Rally: cities. Muster 1: each country, 1 Troop on its lowest-numbered factory (else city). Income: +1 Agent a country a round. Sway 1 toward Discord. Corrupt: cities. Corrupt: land.

events.name: Occupation
events.text: Threat, each country: Security 2 or Cyber 2, and Diplomacy 2. Rally: research stations. Muster 1: each country, 1 Troop on its lowest-numbered factory (else city). Income: +1 Agent a country a round. Corrupt: research stations. Corrupt: cities (1 fewer).

events.name: Naval Blockade
events.text: Threat, each country: Industry 2 or Power 2, and Security 2 or Cyber 2. Rally: coastal cities. Muster 1: each country, 1 Troop on its lowest-numbered factory (else city). Until the end of next round, cities make no energy. Income: +1 Agent a country a round. Corrupt: cities. Corrupt: land.
